points.description: The answer conveys that the collision domain diameter decreases when the speed is increased tenfold, by a factor of 10 (so diameter is inversely proportional to speed). Equivalent wording, or a correct numerical example such as 300m falling to 30m, earns the mark. Saying it increases or stays the same earns no mark.

rubric.notes: The whole question rests on one idea: the diameter falls by a factor of 10 when speed rises tenfold. Full marks if the student states this direction and magnitude in any equivalent words. No marks if the student says the diameter increases, stays the same, or gives only a vague change with no reduction.
